subject: Draft MAP + kickoff doc: Brightpath evaluation timeline
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@brightpath.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft MAP + kickoff doc: Brightpath evaluation timeline

Hi Tom —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. As promised, I drafted a compact MAP (mutual action plan) and a one-slide timeline to help align stakeholders and shorten decision cycles. The doc is a work-in-progress but should give your PM and procurement teams a clear week-by-week view for a 30-day pilot + procurement path.

Quick overview of what's in the draft:
- Week 0: sandbox access + integration checklist (engineering owners identified)
- Week 1: core function validation (latency/cost targets, 3 representative prompts)
- Week 2: scale test + perf/quality tradeoffs (quantization/throughput options)
- Week 3: acceptance testing + contract/ops handoff
- Procurement lane: simple milestone-based PO suggestion and estimated timeline

Can you share a preferred single GDoc where your PMs can comment? I put a version in our drive and toggled comment access for your address: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Aq-demo-redwood-map-template

Ben — copying you to add the compact slide and suggested acceptance criteria.

Next steps I propose:
1) You and your PM add comments to the GDoc by end of week (EOW)
2) We sync for 30 minutes after comments to lock the acceptance matrix
3) Redwood sends a short procurement timeline proposal for signature-ready terms

If that cadence works, I can book the 30 minute sync (proposed Thu or Fri).

Best,
Laura

Laura —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the clear lanes. I shared the doc with our PM (Maya Solano) and Ops lead; they asked for a procurement-oriented timeline that maps to our internal approval gates. Attached is a simple procurement worksheet that shows our legal review windows and preferred PO milestones.

Two asks from my side:
- Can we add an explicit step to validate data residency + logging behavior during Week 1 (our security folks require that before any sandbox sign-off)?
- Procurement prefers milestone payments split (PO upon sandbox access, payment on pilot acceptance). I can mark which milestones align to those payments in the worksheet.

I can do a Thursday 11:00 AM PT sync if that works for you and Ben.

Thanks,
Tom

Thanks Tom — good call on surfacing the security/ops gate early. I updated the GDoc to include a "Security & Compliance" checklist under Week 1 with the following items:
- data residency confirmation (region, retention policy)
- sample audit log dump and schema (to validate ingestion)
- KMS integration notes + contact for our infra team

I also added a short procurement lane with two suggested milestones:
1) Sandbox & initial access (PO triggers sandbox provisioning)
2) Pilot acceptance (final acceptance sign-off, invoicing)

Link to draft slide (quick one-pager): https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1Bq-demo-redwood-map-slide

Laura — I've left a couple inline comments asking for the acceptance test prompt set (3 prompts) and whether Brightpath wants throughput > latency SLO or vice versa (we can recommend batching/quantization profile based on that).

I'll be on the 11:00am PT call on Thursday.
